NBARating.description: Custom formula to rate the performance of a player based on points, assists, steals, blocks, turnovers, rebounds, three pointers, and free throws

assistRatio.description: The percentage of a team's possessions that ends in an assist. Assist Ratio = (Assists x 100) divided by [(FGA + (FTA x 0.44) + Assists + Turnovers].

assistTurnoverRatio.description: The average number of assists a player or team records per turnover

assists.description: The number of times a player who passes the ball to a teammate in a way that leads to a score by field goal, meaning that he or she was "assisting" in the basket. There is some judgment involved in deciding whether a passer should be credited with an assist.

avg48Assists.description: The average number of assists per 48 minutes.

avg48Blocks.description: The average number of blocks per 48 minutes.

avg48DefensiveRebounds.description: The average number of defensive rebounds per 48 minutes.

avg48Disqualifications.description: The average number of disqualifications per 48 minutes.

avg48Ejections.description: The average number of ejections per 48 minutes.

avg48FieldGoalsAttempted.description: The average number of fieldgoals attempted per 48 minutes.

avg48FieldGoalsMade.description: The average number of fieldgoals made per 48 minutes.

avg48FlagrantFouls.description: The average number of flagrant fouls committed per 48 minutes.

avg48Fouls.description: The average number of fouls committed per 48 minutes.

avg48FreeThrowsAttempted.description: The average number of free throws attempted per 48 minutes.

avg48FreeThrowsMade.description: The average number of Free Throws made per 48 minutes.

avg48OffensiveRebounds.description: The average number of offenseive rebounds per 48 minutes.

avg48Points.description: The average number of points scored per 48 minutes.

avg48Rebounds.description: The average number of rebounds per 48 minutes.

avg48Steals.description: The average number of steals per 48 minutes.

avg48TechnicalFouls.description: The average number of technical fouls committed per 48 minutes.

avg48ThreePointFieldGoalsAttempted.description: The average number of 3-pointers attempted per 48 minutes.

avg48ThreePointFieldGoalsMade.description: The average per number of 3-Pointers made per 48 minutes.

avg48Turnovers.description: The average number of turnovers per 48 minutes.

avgDefensiveRebounds.description: The average defensive rebounds per game.

avgDisqualifications.description: The average number of disqualifications per game.

avgEstimatedPossessions.description: The average number of estimated possessions per game for a team or player.

avgFieldGoalsAttempted.description: The average field goals attempted per game.

avgFieldGoalsMade.description: The average field goals made per game.

avgFlagrantFouls.description: The average number of flagrant fouls per game.

avgFouls.description: The average fouls committed per game.

avgFreeThrowsAttempted.description: The average free throw shots attempted per game.

avgFreeThrowsMade.description: The average free throw shots made per game.

avgMinutes.description: The average number of minutes per game.

avgOffensiveRebounds.description: The average offensive rebounds per game.

avgPoints.description: The average number of points scored per game.

avgTeamRebounds.description: The average number of rebounds for a team per game.

avgTeamTurnovers.description: The average number of turnovers for a team per game.

avgTechnicalFouls.description: The average number of technical fouls per game.

avgThreePointFieldGoalsAttempted.description: The average three point field goals attempted per game.

avgThreePointFieldGoalsMade.description: The average three point field goals made per game.

avgTotalTurnovers.description: The average number of total turnovers for a team per game.

avgTurnovers.description: The average turnovers committed per game.

avgTwoPointFieldGoalsAttempted.description: The number of 2-point field goals attempted per game for a team or player.

avgTwoPointFieldGoalsMade.description: The number of 2-point field goals made per game for a team or player.

blockFoulRatio.description: The average number of blocks a player or record per foul committed.

blocks.description: Short for blocked shot, number of times when a defensive player legally deflects a field goal attempt from an offensive player.

defReboundRate.description: The percentage of missed shots that a team rebounds defensively. Rebound Rate = (Defensive Rebounds x Team Minutes) divided by [Player Minutes x (Team Defensive Rebounds + Opponent Defensive Rebounds)].

defensiveRebounds.description: The number of times when the defense obtains the possession of the ball after a missed shot by the offense.

disqualifications.description: The number of times a player reached the foul limit.

doubleDouble.description: The number of times double digit values were accumulated in 2 of the following categories: points, rebounds, assists, steals, and blocked shots

effectiveFGPct.description: Metric that gives 3pt field goals more worth than 2pt field goals: (FGM + (0.5 x 3PTM)) / FGA

ejections.description: The number of times a player or coach is removed from the game as a result of a serious offense.

estimatedPossessions.description: An estimation of the number of possessions for a team or player.

fantasyRating.description: The Fantasy Rating of a player.

fastBreakPoints.description: The number of points scored on fast breaks.

fieldGoalPct.description: The ratio of field goals made to field goals attempted: FGM / FGA

fieldGoalsAttempted.description: The number of times a 2pt field goal was attempted.

fieldGoalsMade.description: The number of times a 2pt field goal was made.

flagrantFouls.description: The number of fouls that the officials thought were unnecessary or excessive.

fouls.description: The number of times a player had illegal contact with the opponent.

freeThrowPct.description: The ratio of free throws made to free throws attempted: FTM / FTA

freeThrowsAttempted.description: The number of times a free throw was attempted.

freeThrowsMade.description: The number of times a free throw was made.

gameDayOfYear.description: The day of the season on which this game falls; if it's the 15th day of the regular season in Nov, the game day of year is 15 (ie, game day of year != day of year).

gamesStarted.description: The number of games started by an athlete.

minutes.description: The total number of minutes played.

offReboundRate.description: The percentage of missed shots that a team rebounds offensively. Offensive Rebound Rate = (Offensive Rebounds x Team Minutes) divided by [Player Minutes x (Team Offensive Rebounds + Opponent Defensive Rebounds)].

offensiveReboundPct.description: The percentage of the number of times they obtain the possession of the ball after a missed shot.

offensiveRebounds.description: The number of times when the offense obtains the possession of the ball after a missed shot.

paceFactor.description: The number of possessions a team uses per game.

plusMinus.description: A player's estimated on-court impact on team performance measured in point differential per 100 possessions.

pointsInPaint.description: The amount of points scored in the area known as "the Paint"(the rectangle between the foul line and the baseline).

pointsPerEstimatedPossessions.description: The number of points per estimated possession for a team or player

possessions.description: The total number of possessions for a team or player.

reboundRate.description: The percentage of missed shots that a team rebounds. Rebound Rate = (Rebounds x Team Minutes) divided by [Player Minutes x (Team Rebounds + Opponent Rebounds)]

rebounds.description: The total number of rebounds (offensive and defensive).

scoringEfficiency.description: The efficiency with which a team or player scores the basketball.

shootingEfficiency.description: The efficiency with which a team or player shoots the basketball.

stealFoulRatio.description: The average number of steals a player or team records per foul committed.

stealTurnoverRatio.description: The number of steals per turnover

steals.description: The number of times a defensive player forced a turnover by intercepting or deflecting a pass or a dribble of an offensive player.

teamAssistTurnoverRatio.description: The number of assists per turnover for a team

teamRebounds.description: The total number of rebounds for a team

teamTurnovers.description: The number of turnovers for the team.

technicalFouls.description: The number of times an player or coach was called for a technical foul (unsportsmanlike conduct or violations).

threePointFieldGoalPct.description: The ratio of 3pt field goals made to 3pt field goals attempted: 3PM / 3PA.

threePointFieldGoalsAttempted.description: The number of times a 3pt field goal was attempted.

threePointFieldGoalsMade.description: The number of times a 3pt field goal was made.

threePointPct.description: The ratio of 3pt field goals made to 3pt field goals attempted: 3PM / 3PA.

totalRebounds.description: The total number of rebounds for a team or player

totalTechnicalFouls.description: The total number of technical fouls for a team or player

totalTurnovers.description: The number of turnovers plus team turnovers for the team.

tripleDouble.description: The number of times double digit values were accumulated in 3 of the following categories: points, rebounds, assists, steals, and blocked shots

trueShootingPct.description: What a team's shooting percentage would be if we accounted for free throws and 3-pointers. True Shooting Percentage = (Total points x 50) divided by [(FGA + (FTA x 0.44)].

turnoverPoints.description: The amount of points resulting from the possession following a turnover.

turnoverRatio.description: The percentage of a team's possessions that end in a turnover. Turnover Ratio = (Turnover x 100) divided by [(FGA + (FTA x 0.44) + Assists + Turnovers].

turnovers.description: The number of times a player loses possession to the other team.

twoPointFieldGoalPct.description: The percentage of 2-points fields goals made by a team or player.

twoPointFieldGoalsAttempted.description: The number of 2-point field goals attempted for a team or player.

twoPointFieldGoalsMade.description: The number of 2-point field goals made for a team or player.
